disagreements.source_a: GamesRadar and Roblox Den report 20MVISIT, 45KLIKE, JACKAL, SILVERINE and TOURNAMENT as current.
disagreements.source_b: Pocket Tactics lists the same five codes as expired.
disagreements.confirmed: Freetins did not redeem the codes, so their status remains a source disagreement.

disagreements.source_a: Pocket Tactics and Roblox Den report 25 Lucky Spins and 3 Exotic Ingots.
disagreements.source_b: GamesRadar reports 30 Lucky Spins and 4 Exotic Ingots.
disagreements.confirmed: The shared parts are 4 Aspect Gems and 3 Perfect Reforge Stones; the other amounts are unresolved.

disagreements.source_a: Pocket Tactics and Roblox Den report 30 Normal Spins for each code.
disagreements.source_b: GamesRadar reports 20 Normal Spins for each code.
disagreements.confirmed: All three sources report 10 Lucky Spins; Freetins did not resolve the Normal Spin amount in game.

unverified_summary: Freetins did not redeem these codes. Current guides disagree on the status of five older strings and on some UPDATE2_5, MOONWITCH and NECROMANCER reward amounts. The table preserves each unresolved difference instead of selecting an unsupported value.

next_change.pattern: Publisher announcements can change rewards and requirements. No fixed code-release schedule is established.
